profile.headline: SWE @ Mastercard
profile.summary: I am a software engineer at Mastercard. I currently work on Front-End using the React framework. I provide Risk Analysis to Acquirers and Issuers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: I take on more complex projects and responsibilities. I collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. My work includes developing high-performing, scalable software solutions and contributing to the backend development using Java Spring Boot, while continuing to work with React to enhance the robustness and scalability of our applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: I was part of a dynamic team focused on enhancing the company's digital presence and improving customer engagement. I contributed to the development of various applications using React, ensuring they met Mastercard's accessibility and design standards. My role involved debugging complex scenarios and collaborating with team members to resolve issues efficiently. I also played a key role in developing high-quality software products, ensuring their reliability and performance.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: As an Android developer specializing in front-end design, I focused on creating user-friendly interfaces using Android Studio and Kotlin. I collaborated closely with the iOS and back-end teams to ensure seamless integration across platforms. My primary project involved developing an app that provided customers with detailed information about products' sustainability labels, enhancing their awareness and promoting eco-friendly choices.

positions.title: Corporate Relations Director
positions.description: I helped my organization connect with college recruiters and companies. I organized events such as Resume Workshops, LinkedIn Workshops, and networking events. Additionally, I created partnerships and secured sponsorships to support our initiatives.
